body: Thank you, @FlamingFireCoding. Triage: `enhancement`, `P6`, `effort:high` (it changes the toolpath of 3D Finish, so it is under our safety floor even though the switch itself is small), `area:3d`. One point the work must keep: with the waterline pass off, steep flanks get only the raster lines, which can leave large scallops or uncut material there. The operation should say so (a note on the result, not a silent change), and rest-material checks downstream must see the leftover. If you have a part where you want this, a screenshot of the area helps.
